outline.description: lake shoreline [[x, z], …] in the entity space (at most 64 points); unset is the open sea. It need not follow the ground: the terrain hides what is below it

extent.description: how far from the camera the sea reaches; unit: m

clarity.description: how far light travels in the water before 1/e of it is left (clear lakes 10+, muddy rivers below 1); unit: m

height.description: height of the largest waves; unit: m

length.description: wavelength of the longest waves; unit: m

direction.description: where the waves travel (0 is local +X, counterclockwise); unit: °

choppiness.description: how much the crests bunch up (0 round, 1 sharp)

wind.description: wind speed driving the waves; unit: m/s

patch.description: size of the largest wave tile (two finer tiles are 1/6 and 1/36 of it); unit: m

spectrum.description: FFT ocean waves from a wind spectrum instead of the Gerstner waves (unset height follows the wind)

waves.description: Gerstner waves (or an FFT wind spectrum), flattened far from the camera

rise.description: how far the water rises after long heavy rain (unset: lakes 0.5, rivers 0.6, the sea 0); unit: m

caustics.description: how strong the light patterns the waves focus onto the bottom are (0 none; rivers have none)

shore.description: foam where the water is shallower than this; unit: m

spline.description: the river spline (profile river; its width is the water width); content path of a spline asset (no extension)

level.description: how far the water surface is below the spline; unit: m

speed.description: how fast the ripples flow along the spline; unit: m/s

river.description: a river along a spline instead of a lake or sea
